name: Silver Ortofon
original_name: シルバー・オルトフォン
source: Silver is a butler attached to Arcadare family. He's also a father of Lillet and he's just as idiotic and perverted as his daughter, although he keeps looking like a normal butler, when serious. Silver may act as a bodyguard and pocesses the priest powers. He was the one, who sealed a powerful demon, Rain.
